div.div:
مِفَنٌّ A man who has various sorts, or modes, [i. e. diversities, or varieties,] of speech; (T, TA;) and so ↓ مُتَفَنِّنٌ : (S:) or a man who utters, or performs, wonderful things: (S, K, TA:) fem. with ة. (T, S, K.) ―
-b2- And A horse that performs various sorts, or modes, of running. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
